title: slicer check should warn when a Files entry has an anchor that is not :N or :N-M, so the path is not silently dropped

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (deterministic-check) on slicer in ork run ork-20261118-130536-390b, project ork, item S398:

slicer check should warn when a Files entry has an anchor that is not :N or :N-M, so the path is not silently dropped

Evidence: S398 Files has `docs/design.md:890-896,2925-2929` and the slice's paths omit docs/design.md while slicer check passes
